```{r}
sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1yBd8ifEPHZ9EVhUWU2qNg6GV-W5EqIqvbT1iSLjNUjs/edit?gid=2009146012#gid=2009146012"

sheet_names(sheet_url)
```

```{r}
Chaminade <- read_sheet(sheet_url, sheet = "Sheet1")
HPU <- read_sheet(sheet_url, sheet = "Sheet2")
Hilo <- read_sheet(sheet_url, sheet = "Sheet3")
Dominican <- read_sheet(sheet_url, sheet = "Sheet4")

xG <- read_sheet(sheet_url, sheet = "Sheet14")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

Point_Loma <- Point_Loma %>%
  mutate(
    xG_for     = (`SoT for` * 0.246) + ((`Total shots for` - `SoT for`) * 0.070),
    xG_against = (`SoT against` * 0.246) + ((`Total shots against` - `SoT against`) * 0.070),
    xG_diff    = xG_for - xG_against,
    xResult    = case_when(
      xG_diff >= 0.5  ~ "W",
      xG_diff <= -0.5 ~ "L",
      TRUE            ~ "D"
    ),
    Result = case_when(
      Goals == `Goals against` ~ "D",
      Goals > `Goals against`  ~ "W",
      Goals < `Goals against`  ~ "L"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

library(tidyr)

  Point_Loma, Azusa, Biola, Chaminade, Concordia, Dominican,
  Fresno, Hilo, HPU, Jessup, Menlo, Vanguard, Westmont
)
```

```{r}
Azusa <- Azusa[-11, ]

sum(Azusa$Goals)
sum(Azusa$`Goals against`)
sum(Azusa$`Total shots for`)
sum(Azusa$`Total shots against`)
sum(Azusa$`SoT for`)
sum(Azusa$`SoT against`)
sum(Azusa$`xG_for`)
sum(Azusa$`xG_against`)
sum(Azusa$`xG_diff`)
```

```{r}
sum(Azusa$xResult == "W", na.rm = TRUE)
sum(Azusa$xResult == "D", na.rm = TRUE)
sum(Azusa$xResult == "L", na.rm = TRUE)

sum(Azusa$Result == "W", na.rm = TRUE)
sum(Azusa$Result == "D", na.rm = TRUE)
sum(Azusa$Result == "L", na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
Azusa_points <- Azusa %>%
  mutate(
    Points  = case_when(
      Result == "W" ~ 3,
      Result == "D" ~ 1,
      Result == "L" ~ 0
    ),
    xPoints = case_when(
      xResult == "W" ~ 3,
      xResult == "D" ~ 1,
      xResult == "L" ~ 0
    )
  )
 
sum(Azusa$Points,  na.rm = TRUE)   
sum(Azusa$xPoints, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
Azusa_totals <- Azusa_points %>%
  summarize(
    across(where(is.numeric), sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
 
print(Azusa_totals)
```

```{r}
ggplot(all_totals, aes(x = reorder(Team, -Points), y = Points)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E86AB") +
  labs(title = "PacWest Standings by Points", x = NULL, y = "Points") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(all_totals, aes(x = reorder(Team, -xPoints), y = xPoints)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#F5A623") +
  labs(title = "PacWest Standings by xPoints", x = NULL, y = "xPoints") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(gt)
 
# --- Build the standings table ---
standings <- all_totals %>%
  mutate(
    GP      = 10,
    GD      = Goals - `Goals against`,
    PtsDiff = Points - xPoints
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Points), desc(GD)) %>%      # rank by points, tiebreak on goal difference
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
  select(
    Rank, Team, GP,
    GF = Goals, GA = `Goals against`, GD,
    Pts = Points, xPts = xPoints,
    `Pts - xPts` = PtsDiff,
    xGD = xG_diff
  )
 
# --- Format as a league table ---
standings_table <- gt(standings) %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "PacWest League Standings",
    subtitle = "10-game sample | Pts - xPts: blue = earning more points than shots suggest"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = xGD, decimals = 1) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = `Pts - xPts`,
    palette = c("#D64545", "white", "#2E86AB"),
    domain  = c(-6, 6)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = everything()) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Team) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = c(Team, Pts))
  )
 
standings_table
 
# --- Optional: save as an image ---
# gtsave(standings_table, "pacwest_standings.png")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
 
# standings in order by points, using GD as a tiebreaker
standings <- all_totals %>%
  mutate(GD = Goals - `Goals against`) %>%
  arrange(desc(Points), desc(GD)) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank  = row_number(),
    Label = factor(paste0(Rank, ". ", Team), levels = rev(paste0(Rank, ". ", Team)))
  )
 
# league table bar chart
ggplot(standings, aes(x = Label, y = Points)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E86AB") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(Points, " pts  (GD ", ifelse(GD > 0, "+", ""), GD, ")")),
    hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.3))) +
  labs(title = "PacWest Standings", x = NULL, y = "Points") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# standings in order by xPoints, using xGD as a tiebreaker
xStandings <- all_totals %>%
  mutate(xGD = xG_for - xG_against) %>%
  arrange(desc(xPoints), desc(xGD)) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank  = row_number(),
    Label = factor(paste0(Rank, ". ", Team), levels = rev(paste0(Rank, ". ", Team)))
  )
 
# league table bar chart
ggplot(xStandings, aes(x = Label, y = xPoints)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#F5A623") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(xPoints, " xPts  (xGD ", ifelse(xGD > 0, "+", ""), round(xGD, 1), ")")),
    hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.3))) +
  labs(title = "Expected PacWest Standings", x = NULL, y = "xPoints") +
  theme_minimal()
```
